projectTitle: Clarkson University: A Drupal 9 site on one domain
project_haiku: Clarkson hired Carnegie to rethink the university site and Knectar to build it. The result is Drupal 9 on Pantheon: one site, editors working in Paragraphs, and the old Drupal 8 content brought across.
project_footer_CTA: Need a university site your editors can assemble, on a platform you can keep? We built that for Clarkson.
pageSummary:
The job

In 2022 Clarkson University asked Carnegie, formerly mStoner, to reimagine the institutional site. Discovery called for the brand and the three campuses to read as one place, for WCAG 2.1 AA, and for faculty, events, and alerts to stop living on separate systems. Carnegie wrote the strategy and the technical blueprint. Knectar implemented it.

What we built

The site is Drupal 9 on Pantheon. Drupal 8 content and the scattered subdomains came into that one site. Editors build pages from Paragraphs: heroes, statistics, features, testimonials. The front end is the from-scratch code Carnegie specified, with PostCSS and webpack, so the university kept a style guide it can own. The blueprint also covered PeopleSoft for faculty, EMS for events, Rave Alert for emergencies, personalization through Clarity, and search through Funnelback.

Outcomes

Clarkson has one public site, a CMS distributed editors can use, and a front end the university can keep maintaining after the launch team is gone.
